question: For the function $f(x) = x^4 - 4x^3 + 10$, determine the coordinates of the local minimum, if any.
explanation:
$f'(x)=4x^3-12x^2=4x^2(x-3)$.

Critical points are $x=0$ and $x=3$.

Second derivative $f''(x)=12x^2-24x$.

$f''(3)=36>0$ so local minimum at $x=3$.

$f(3)=81-108+10=-17$.

Thus local minimum is at $(3,-17)$.
